summary: According to the drug label, you should speak with a health professional before use if you are pregnant, breast-feeding, have never been diagnosed with migraines, or have a headache that feels different from your usual ones [3]. The label also warns to keep the product away from children and to talk to a health professional if your symptoms do not improve or get worse [3]. In addition, computer model predictions—which come from a small digital program rather than tests in humans—placed the drug in the low band for liver and heart scores [M].
